privacy.ai_training_note: By default Glide trains its AI models on customer content and app structure starting October 1, 2024. Training excludes data 'that relates to an identifiable individual.' Opt-out is only available if 'your account type grants you the ability to opt out' (enterprise/paid tiers). Shared Template Store developers CANNOT opt out: 'by listing a Shared Template on the Template Store, you agree that, notwithstanding any permitted opt out of other artificial intelligence training, Glide may use any of Your Content included in the Shared Template...to train its artificial intelligence algorithms and models.' After opt-out, Glide will not revert prior training. AI features use OpenAI as a subprocessor; per the DPA, OpenAI does not use API customer data to retrain its models.

flags: Glide trains its AI on customer content starting October 1, 2024 unless the customer opts out; opting out is only available for certain paid and enterprise account types.
Users who list apps in the Template Store cannot opt out of AI training on that content, regardless of account tier.
Once training has occurred, opting out does not remove or revert previously trained model data.
There is no HIPAA support: PHI is explicitly prohibited in the User Data Rules, and Glide must not be used for healthcare workloads involving protected health information.
ISO 27001 appears as a referenced framework on Glide's security page, but no formal certification is claimed or evidenced; Glide should not be treated as ISO 27001 certified.
All data is hosted on GCP in Iowa, USA. No EU or regional data residency options are documented, which may be a concern for EU-regulated customers.
Glide AI features route data through OpenAI's API. OpenAI does not retrain on API customer data, but customers should be aware of this subprocessor relationship.
A signed DPA copy must be requested via email to dpo@glideapps.com rather than being available for self-service download.
